scripts.desktop:preview: bun run build && tauri dev --no-watch --config src-tauri/tauri.preview.conf.json
scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && bun run check:packages
scripts.check:packages: tsgo -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsgo -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsgo -p packages/prompts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsgo -p packages/agents/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsgo -p packages/workbench-engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:packages:tsc: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/prompts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agents/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/workbench-engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit
